description: Renders wikitext through the live wiki without saving. Returns HTML, parse warnings, categories, wikilinks, templates, external URLs, and display title. Suited to dry-running a planned edit before create-page or update-page, or previewing standalone wikitext (template combinations, sanitizer checks) with no target page. HTML output is truncated at 75000 bytes by default, with a marker reporting how much of it was returned; a smaller wikitext fragment in a follow-up call returns the rest.

applyPreSaveTransform.description: Apply pre-save transform (expand ~~~~ signatures, {{subst:}}, normalize whitespace). Matches editor "Show preview" behavior.

title.description: Wiki page title providing context for magic words like {{PAGENAME}}. Defaults to "API".

wiki.description: Wiki to target, as a key from the mcp://wikis/ resources (e.g. en.wikipedia.org), or the full mcp://wikis/ URI. Omit to use the default wiki.

name: parse-wikitext
